description.en: A cute, Animal Crossing-inspired React UI component library featuring delightful micro-interactions and hand-drawn styling.
description.zh: 动森风格的温馨治愈系 React UI 组件库，具备细腻可爱的微交互与手绘插画风格。

content.en: Animal Island UI is a comprehensive React component library inspired by the cozy aesthetic of Animal Crossing. It provides over 30 production-ready components ranging from essential inputs and navigation to playful cursors, countdowns, and typewriter text animations. All components feature rounded silhouettes, warm earth-tone palettes, bouncy micro-interactions, and full TypeScript typing.
content.zh: Animal Island UI 是一套灵感汲取自《集合啦！动物森友会》的轻量 React 组件库。全套收录了从基础表单输入、按钮卡片，到个性化游标、倒计时、打字机打字动效等逾 30 款开箱即用的 UI 组件。整套组件以圆润的造型曲线、温暖治愈的自然配色以及弹性微交互见长，自带完整的 TypeScript 类型支持。
